name: herwig
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "7.2.0"

package:
  name: herwig
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://herwig.hepforge.org/downloads/Herwig-${{ version }}.tar.bz2
    sha256: 5933545ddff7fde2bea86fa61943fba5d4be50ba993c336e9a372529a2f2b164
    patches:
      - determine-length-of-compiled-in-install-paths-at-run.patch
      - link-against-an-external-looptools-library.patch
  # 'make install' runs 'Herwig init' to create the default repository
  # HerwigDefaults.rpo, which fails if the default PDF sets are not installed.
  # The PDF sets are only used during the build and are not packaged.
  - url: https://lhapdfsets.web.cern.ch/current/CT14lo.tar.gz
    sha256: 5554b2f66027accc3fe38b55b846d5c7c6d771283868187870bf9c86e5c46678
    target_directory: pdfsets/CT14lo
  - url: https://lhapdfsets.web.cern.ch/current/CT14nlo.tar.gz
    sha256: ad62063067e1d73942b1aadcaff2e50a6b2e2d28ad989e8bd3eee5f48e05f18c
    target_directory: pdfsets/CT14nlo

build:
  number: 2
  skip:
    - win
    - osx
  script:
    - export LHAPDF_DATA_PATH="${SRC_DIR}/pdfsets"
    # libThePEG is installed under lib/ThePEG, which is not on the default rpath
    - export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -Wl,-rpath,${PREFIX}/lib/ThePEG"

    # Herwig bundles a modified copy of LoopTools 2.13. Remove its sources so that
    # only the looptools library can be used, and regenerate the build system
    # for the patched Looptools/Makefile.am.
    # Herwig's changes to the removed sources do not affect results, and its C++
    # interface (Herwig::Looptools) is kept. Results with LoopTools 2.16 agree
    # with the bundled copy to a relative difference of 1.5e-14.
    - rm -rf Looptools/{A,B,C,D,E,util}
    - autoreconf --force --install

    # Get an updated config.sub and config.guess
    # Herwig sets AC_CONFIG_AUX_DIR([Config]) in configure.ac, so configure looks for them in Config/
    - cp $BUILD_PREFIX/share/gnuconfig/config.* ./Config

    - ./configure --help
    - ./configure --prefix=${PREFIX} --with-thepeg=${PREFIX} --with-fastjet=${PREFIX} --with-gsl=${PREFIX} --with-boost=${PREFIX}
    - make -j${CPU_COUNT}
    - make install

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("fortran") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - make
    - pkg-config
    - gnuconfig
    - autoconf
    - automake
    - libtool
  host:
    - fastjet-cxx  # pick up global pinning
    # Provides fastjet-config, which configure uses to find FastJet
    - fastjet-cxx-devel
    - gsl
    - libboost-headers
    - looptools
    # Herwig 7.2 is the release series for ThePEG 2.2
    - thepeg 2.2.*
  run:
    - python
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("herwig", upper_bound="x.x") }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - Herwig
        - herwig-config
        - herwig-combinedistributions
        - herwig-combineruns
        - herwig-makedistributions
        - herwig-mergegrids
        - gosam2herwig
        - mg2herwig
        - slha2herwig
        - ufo2herwig
      include:
        - Herwig/API/HerwigAPI.h
      files:
        - lib/Herwig/libHerwigAPI.so
        - lib/Herwig/Herwig.so
        - lib/Herwig/Hw*.so
        - share/Herwig/HerwigDefaults.rpo
        - share/Herwig/LHC.in
  - script:
      - Herwig --version
      # The default PDF sets are not shipped with the package
      - lhapdf install CT14lo CT14nlo &> /dev/null
      - Herwig read ${PREFIX}/share/Herwig/LHC-Matchbox.in
      - Herwig run LHC-Matchbox.run -N 100
      # The loop induced Higgs decays of the MSSM use LoopTools
      - cp ${PREFIX}/share/Herwig/CMSSM40.1.1.slha .
      - Herwig read ${PREFIX}/share/Herwig/LHC-MSSM.in

about:
  homepage: https://herwig.hepforge.org/
  summary: 'Multi-purpose particle physics event generator'
  description: |
    Herwig provides significantly improved and extended physics capabilities when compared to both its predecessors,
    HERWIG 6 and Herwig++ 2, while keeping the key model motivations such as coherent parton showers (including
    angular-ordered and dipole-based evolution), the cluster hadronization model, an eikonal multiple-interaction model,
    highly flexible BSM capabilities and improved perturbative input using next-to-leading order QCD.

    The default PDF sets used by Herwig are not distributed with the package and need to be installed with
    `lhapdf install CT14lo CT14nlo`.
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  documentation: https://herwig.hepforge.org/doxygen/
  repository: https://repo.hepforge.org/source/herwighg/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - utk4r-sh
    - GiacomoXT
    - vvsagar
    - AlexanderHeidelbach
    - conda-forge/hepmc3
